title: Monitoring & Freshness
subtitle: Defines when a vehicle counts as reporting and how far back the map looks. These values drive the colours and counters the whole operation sees.

en_vivo.label: "Live" threshold (minutes)
en_vivo.tooltip: A vehicle whose last point is newer than this shows green and pulsing. Lowering it makes the map stricter.

inactivo.label: "Idle" threshold (minutes)
inactivo.tooltip: Between the "Live" threshold and this value the vehicle shows amber. Past this value it turns grey as "No signal".

ventana.label: Map window (hours)
ventana.tooltip: How far back the map looks for each vehicle's last position. A vehicle with no points in this period does not appear on the map.

preview.title: Resulting scale
preview.window: Off the map: no points in {{h}} h

notes.window_cap: The cap is 168 h (7 days). It is not arbitrary: the telemetry table is partitioned by month and a longer window forces the database to read whole partitions on every map query.
notes.order: The "Idle" threshold must be greater than the "Live" one, otherwise no vehicle would ever reach that state.
notes.adjusted: Values were adjusted to the allowed limits.

validation.order: Must be greater than the "Live" threshold ({{n}})
